verdict.rationale: Composing reusable sub-workflows is a fair question for a workflow orchestration platform like Temporal, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents child workflows or workflows calling other workflows as reusable modules. The pack only covers general Workflow/Activity primitives, Workflows-as-Code, Standalone Activities, versioning and Schedules, none of which is this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compose reusable sub-workflows or modules that other workflows call
